concepts.definition: Tier-1 document owning bounded-work procedure: steps, transitions, intake, execution units, admission, applicability and exclusion, output, configurations, delegation, context construction and fit, acquisition, activation, evaluation, derived-surface staleness, result refinements, disposition, totality, refinement, licensing, work state, restart, proportionality, resource limits, closed results and reuse. It uses, without redefining, the objects and result algebra owned by FOUNDATIONS and the frame object and activate outcomes owned by REFERENCE_FRAME.

grounding.quote:
it redefines nothing those
members own.

concepts.label: ACTIVATION document

concepts.definition: Activation of one reference frame or one declared active frame configuration on an exact subject. Its context is the activated frame's projection to the actor, never the corpus or workspace. Intake, admission, applicability and activation remain distinct even within one invocation.

grounding.quote:
Intake, admission,
applicability and activation are distinct relations inside the step even
when one invocation performs all of them.

concepts.label: Step

concepts.definition: Source-authored foundation-to-law traces distinguish premises, their standing, consequences, owning rules, added domain or policy choices, pillars and consumers. The transitions/steps/configuration family covers §§1 and 4; the work-state/resumption/reuse family covers §§5 and 7. These traces describe the subject's reasoning and ownership, not a derivation performed by this interpretation.

grounding.quote:
They are conditions of the work this family governs,
not commitments, and do not follow from finite capacity alone.

They are conditions of the work this family governs, not
commitments, and do not follow from finite capacity alone.

concepts.label: Foundation-to-law traces

concepts.definition: Material workspace state and authoritative inputs together with justified knowledge and explicit unknowns. Work state records its workspace, governing basis, still-applicable closed results and judgments, residuals and uncertainty about external effects. An actor's context is an account of this state, not the state itself.

grounding.quote:
An actor's context is an account of the
current state, not the state itself

concepts.label: Current state

concepts.definition: Owner-defined constraints comprising the selected outcome, its acceptance conditions and governing obligations to preserve. Multiple realised states may satisfy it. Construction denotes this predicate by Z; its governing specification supplies it through the selected WHAT across Intent, Product and Specification, whose descriptions refine it.

grounding.quote:
It names no single
state: its acceptance conditions admit several realised states.

The
governing specification, the selected WHAT across the Intent, Product and
Specification of the Product that owns the work, supplies Z; its
descriptions refine Z.

concepts.label: Destination

concepts.definition: Bounded change from current to next state carried out by one step. Work fitting one activation has one transition; work exceeding it is refined into bounded transitions, each with its own step, under §4. Each binds applicable outer destination obligations and obligations of affected governing relations.

grounding.quote:
A transition is a bounded change from the current state to a next state,
carried out by one step.

concepts.label: Transition

concepts.definition: The corpus's single owning construction relation binds current state A and destination Z, selects work, composes steps, corrects discrepancies and supports completion claims. It is described as carrying the owning Product's common construction requirement and universal construction model. Its consumers apply it without establishing a second relation.

grounding.quote:
This subsection states the construction relation for this corpus: how a
selected construction binds its current state and destination, chooses
its work, composes its steps, corrects itself and claims completion.

concepts.label: Construction relation

concepts.definition: Three distinct subject accounts: specification models required conditions; observations describe what holds; a causal or predictive model explains possible state changes from actions. These differ from FOUNDATIONS' accounts of a construction. Each can be incomplete or wrong differently; predictive-model applicability and adequacy are separate claims.

grounding.quote:
The specification is the internal reference model of the required
conditions. Observations describe what does hold. A causal or
predictive model explains how an action may change the state.

concepts.label: Specification, observations and predictive model

concepts.definition: Arrangement of admissible construction and assurance serving Z within a selected resource envelope. Selection belongs to the realisation and actor exercising admitted work authority. A composition boundary connects a step's output to the next starting state; it is distinct from a categorical join, which maps categories. Feedback observes, compares governing conditions, diagnoses discrepancies, selects an authorised response, acts and observes again; homeostasis is corrective activity, not guaranteed convergence.

grounding.quote:
A strategy arranges admissible construction and assurance to
serve Z within the selected resource envelope.

A composition boundary is the boundary between
successive steps, where one step's output becomes the next step's
starting state.

Homeostasis
means correction towards the required conditions as disturbances and new
observations arise; it guarantees neither convergence nor the adequacy of
those conditions.

concepts.label: Strategy, composition and feedback

concepts.definition: Exact step input contract sufficient to reconstruct governing relations without conversation history, commentary or previous-actor memory. It identifies governed work, subject and basis, permitted inputs, evaluation and result algebra, affected relations and invariants, admission relations, shared computational machinery and binding, authorities and grants, actor envelopes, invalidators, re-entry conditions and applicable cost-claim allowance and spend measurement.

grounding.quote:
A step is activated from an intake sufficient to reconstruct its governing
relations without conversation history, commentary or a prior actor's memory

concepts.label: Intake

concepts.definition: Smallest coherent causal dependency cone capable of delivering working behaviour while preserving every affected governing relation. It need not align with a function, file, module, ticket field or design document. It supplies §2's seed set Z, whose projection is context; this seed-set notation is distinct from construction's destination predicate Z.

grounding.quote:
The execution unit is the smallest coherent causal dependency cone capable
of delivering working behaviour while preserving every affected governing
relation.

concepts.label: Execution unit

concepts.definition: Step contract whose drafting and admission are distinct relations, including inside one invocation. Minimum states are drafted, admitted, rejected and superseded. Its admitted result identifies admission mechanism and authority, exact contract identity or digest, decision and evidence, including any human override; it names one durable result and evidence surface.

grounding.quote:
A contract carries at minimum the states drafted, admitted, rejected and
superseded

concepts.label: Execution contract and admission

concepts.definition: Evaluation of whether an obligation applies to the exact subject, owned by the evaluation and scope declarations and decided from sufficient basis-bound facts. Exclusion is the state of an obligation after falsified applicability, not a result of that obligation. Unresolved applicability is distinct from exclusion.

grounding.quote:
An exclusion is the state of the excluded obligation after a
`falsified` applicability result: it is no result, the obligation's own
evaluation is not performed and maps to no core value

concepts.label: Applicability and exclusion

concepts.definition: Candidate plus step-produced facts: judgments and evidence, residuals, observations, authority decisions, provenance and one construction-availability stop state. The actor's internal path is excluded from output and is not governed.

grounding.quote:
The step's output is a candidate plus its step-produced facts: judgments with
their evidence, residuals, observations, authority decisions, provenance, and
one stop state, a value of construction availability (§3).

concepts.label: Step output

concepts.definition: Task-wide allocation of responsibilities and information exchanges to frames; activation binds actors to frames. Its active frame configuration is the part used for one evaluation or decision. Allocation derives from operations, dependencies, actor capabilities and required assurance, which constrain but do not determine its arrangement.

grounding.quote:
A configuration allocates a task's responsibilities and information
exchanges to frames; activation binds an actor to each frame (§2).

concepts.label: Configuration

concepts.definition: Roles are allocated relations over steps, not actor kinds or a fixed inventory. Where present, constructor owns bounded implementation and self-review, assessor independently evaluates a frozen candidate, and decision owner disposes. Other responsibilities may be allocated. A bounded proxy has only the acceptance and advancement permissions declared by the governing authority relation.

grounding.quote:
Roles are relations over steps that a configuration allocates
(Configuration above), not kinds of actor and not a fixed inventory.

concepts.label: Roles and bounded delegation

concepts.definition: Source-described procedure taking seed set Z of intake subject, outcome and affected relations, dependency family R whose changes can alter result, basis validity, evidence sufficiency or authority, and actor envelope B. It computes material closure, projects with recorded seams, tests fit and acquires declared inputs. Context capacity bounds what can be held; attention bounds what can be used.

grounding.quote:
Given a seed set Z (the subject, outcome and affected relations named in the
intake), a relation family R (the dependency relations whose change can
alter the result, basis validity, evidence sufficiency or authority), and
the actor's envelope B:

concepts.label: Context construction under an envelope

concepts.definition: Read-only observation of frame, subject and declared inputs within intake-permitted acquisition. Acquisition is neither admission nor a further actor stage and confers no role, operation or decision. Activation binds reusable frame declarations to exact subject and basis and loads declared material relations and evidence sources. Evaluation applies the activated frame's invariants, evidence rules and result algebra.

grounding.quote:
Acquisition is the read-only observation of the material a
step needs (its frame, its subject and its declared inputs) within the
inputs its intake permits it to acquire

concepts.label: Acquisition, activation and evaluation

concepts.definition: Material copied, projected or compressed from owning sources, including task-projected frames and a current a_c interpretation's task constraint surface. It names its sources and owns no determination. Currentness, fidelity and question-specific sufficiency are distinct.

grounding.quote:
A derived surface is material derived from owning
sources by copying, projection or compression, such as a projected frame
for a task; it names its sources and owns no determination.

- Matching source identities establish only that the surface was derived
  from those sources. They establish neither its fidelity to them nor its
  sufficiency for a question; a surface found insufficient for a named
  question is handled as Acquisition above states.

concepts.label: Derived surface

concepts.definition: Prompt as rendered contract over typed authority, not source law. It projects current authority references, obligations, contracts, boundaries, proof expectations and fallback conditions needed by the step.

grounding.quote:
A prompt is rendered contract over typed authority;
it is not source law.

concepts.label: Prompt contract

concepts.definition: Five source-defined refinements of the core, each answering a different predicate: admission/activation—lawful beginning on exact subject and basis; construction availability—candidate available; disposition—candidate accepted at declared boundary; ambiguity outcome—declared ambiguity resolved on exact basis; effects—intended effect occurred.

grounding.quote:
Each names the question it answers and the
predicate its mapping is for, and maps each of its values to exactly one
core value

concepts.label: Predicate-bound result refinements

concepts.definition: Pre-step outcome domain for lawful admission and activation on exact subject and basis: activated, admission_refused(authority), admission_refused(basis), closure_unresolved, out_of_frame and activation_refusal with its cause. Frame-activation causes and mappings remain owned by REFERENCE_FRAME §5.

grounding.quote:
The outcomes of frame activation are the `activate`
refinement of [REFERENCE_FRAME §5](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#5-method-functions),
which owns their causes, their predicate and their core values.

concepts.label: Admission and activation outcomes

conditions: A step has been lawfully activated.
concepts.definition: Output-existence domain: candidate_ready, refused, incomplete, re_entry_requested(authority), re_entry_requested(basis). Output is the constructed subject for a constructing step or closed results for an assessing step; it remains a candidate until evaluated.

grounding.quote:
A step's output is a candidate until evaluated (FOUNDATIONS §3, P0): the
constructed subject of a constructing step, or the closed results of an
assessing step.

concepts.label: Construction availability

conditions: A decision owner disposes an assessed candidate.
concepts.definition: Acceptance-result domain comprising accept, local_repair, re_enter and reject. It consumes candidate availability and assessment results while remaining separate from both. An assessor's recommendation is decision evidence, never a disposition.

grounding.quote:
An assessor may recommend one; the
recommendation is evidence for the decision owner, never a disposition

concepts.label: Candidate disposition

conditions: An ambiguity is declared.
concepts.definition: Recorded resolution-status domain comprising resolved, carried, escalated and blocked, mapped for whether that ambiguity is resolved on the exact basis.

grounding.quote:
A declared ambiguity is resolved, carried, escalated or blocked, and the
outcome is recorded either way

concepts.label: Ambiguity outcome

conditions: A step has an intended external effect.
concepts.definition: Evidence-bound effect-outcome domain: completed, not_effected and completion_unknown, for attainment of the declared intended outcome. Whether the effect has ended is a separate question. An effect of uncertain completion is completion_unknown or not_effected with its end unestablished.

grounding.quote:
An effectful step's intended external effect has one of three values,
mapped for the predicate "the intended effect occurred"

An effect of uncertain completion is one whose value is
`completion_unknown`, or whose value is `not_effected` with its end not
established.

concepts.label: External effect and end status

concepts.definition: Advance declaration of next moves for every admitted condition class, including an explicit unknown class. Handling options are supported continuation within contract, refinement, recovery, yield, owning-relation re-entry and termination. Hard stops are conditions that halt work regardless of ambiguity-policy risk appetite.

grounding.quote:
Each admitted condition class has a declared
next move, including an explicit unknown class.

concepts.label: Total handling and hard stops

concepts.definition: Refinement decomposes an outer transformation T: A → X into typed steps carrying success predicates P₀ … Pₙ. Rewrite replaces a representation, step or composite with another claimed to preserve meaning. A licensing law is an owner-declared law permitting the operation. Exact steps preserve declared meaning; approximate steps instead require an adequacy relation and an argued composite end-to-end bound.

grounding.quote:
An outer transformation T: A → X with success predicates P₀ … Pₙ
is faithfully refined by steps Tᵢ

A rewrite step replaces a representation, a step or
a composite by another that is claimed to keep its meaning

concepts.label: Refinement, rewrite and licensing

conditions: The transition is material.
concepts.definition: Each admission owner's independent derivation and validation of the complete enclosing relation from authoritative inputs. The relation includes every participant and equality join whose identity, validity, authority, currentness or transition can affect or be affected by admission, plus relevant crossing-seam far sides unless authoritatively excluded.

grounding.quote:
each admission owner is independently
responsible for deriving and validating the complete enclosing relation
from authoritative inputs

concepts.label: Complete enclosing-relation admission

concepts.definition: Qualification of the admission law for every admission owner and supported boundary declared by accepted design. Case applicability follows supported inputs, states and operating or threat model, with explicit observations for direct, composite/nested, forged, ambiguous, stale, mixed-basis, competing-authority, reconstruction, replay and atomic-publication cases.

grounding.quote:
Qualification of the admission law is instantiated for every admission
owner and supported boundary declared by accepted design

concepts.label: Standing structural qualification

concepts.definition: Persistent object tuple: current workspace, governing basis, applicable closed results and judgments with invalidators, residuals and known uncertainty over external effects. Carrier choice belongs to profile or realisation; resumption, checkpointing and progress accounting are generic procedures. Resumption re-enters the same method on current material state, possibly with another actor.
concepts.label: Work state and resumption

concepts.definition: Acceptance binds an exact checkpoint. A preservation checkpoint may retain unfinished or unaccepted work under an existing exact operation grant but is not acceptance, promotion or publication. Restart reconstructs from less than retained work. Progress categories are accepted material movement, prerequisite work, evidence that is not new progress, churn and forecast revision; these are semantic categories, not a numerical algorithm.

grounding.quote: Acceptance binds one exact checkpoint.

These are
semantic categories, not a numeric progress algorithm

concepts.label: Checkpoint, restart and progress categories

grounding.quote:
A route
written `rc.2 RF #anchor` is into
`stdo://releases/v2.5.1-rc.2/standards/REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD.md` and is
provenance only.

constraints.statement: The member defines its introduced step-level concepts and refines the core for admission, activation and steps, without redefining concepts owned by its dependencies. Routes written rc.2 RF #anchor refer to the specified v2.5.1-rc.2 REFERENCE_FRAME_METHOD document as provenance only.
constraints.uncertainty: The referenced owners' full definitions are not supplied.

conditions: Construction is delegated to a probabilistic or agentic worker.
exceptions: Independent live-surface assessment is included where required.

grounding.quote:
The
normative relation runs: accepted governing basis; bounded affected
relation set; selected computational relations; delegated execution and
decision authority; construction and self-review; independent live-surface
assessment where required; one of accept, local repair, re-enter or reject
(§3); the exact accepted checkpoint; the next already-authorised bounded
action (§5).

constraints.statement: The described execution relation preserves the ordered bindings: accepted governing basis, bounded affected relations, selected computational relations, delegated execution and decision authority, construction and self-review, required independent assessment, accept/local repair/re-enter/reject, exact accepted checkpoint, then next already-authorised bounded action.
constraints.uncertainty: This is a description of the source's execution relation, not execution or acceptance.

grounding.quote:
Its instance premises are: (a) a selected
outcome with its acceptance conditions; (b) work that may exceed one
activation's capacity; (c) actors with declared capability envelopes; (d)
an admitted grant.

Its instance premises are: (a) a workspace that
persists across activations; (b) work that spans activations; (c) actors
that may change between activations; (d) external effects in an open
world.

constraints.statement: The first family has instance premises a=selected outcome and acceptance conditions, b=potentially multi-activation work, c=declared actor envelopes, d=admitted grant. Its transition, intake, applicability, configuration, recording, completion, totality, refinement, complete-admission, construction-binding, strategy, composition, diagnosis and progress rows respectively use ab, d, a, bcd, d, a, d, b, d, a, bc, b, a and ab. The work-state family has a=persistent workspace, b=work spanning activations, c=changing actors, d=open-world external effects; its object, account, reconciliation, checkpoint/progress, reuse and transition-evidence rows respectively use ab, ac, d, b, c and c. These are applicability premises, not commitments or consequences of finite capacity alone. The tables call P0 recovered; P1, P2, P3, P4a and P6 independent; P4b derived from P0/P2 with non-reacquirable step-produced facts; P5 derived from P0/P6 with the open-world premise. Added choices retain their named owners.
constraints.uncertainty: FOUNDATIONS §3's account of standing is referenced but unavailable; the claimed derivations are not independently proved here.

exceptions: SPEC_METHOD §8's delivery priority is traced by family F5 at §6; its core results by F3 at §3; tenant computational relations, actors and resource limits by F10 at SPEC_METHOD §11.

grounding.quote:
Each consumer applies the rule and decides nothing the owning section does
not (P2, P6).

Each consumer applies the rule and decides nothing the owning section does
not (P2, P6).

constraints.statement: Consumers apply the owning rule without deciding additional matters. SPEC_METHOD §8 retains ownership: its execution relation applies intake/admission and configuration rules; product-outcome and chain-layer/change-class bindings apply transitions and completion; its allocation of construction, assessment, disposition, return consumer and coordinator applies configuration; its construction binding applies A/Z, strategy, composition, diagnosis and progress rules. Construction consumers state no second construction relation; domain strategy, actor configuration, mechanisms and additional assurance retain their owners.
constraints.uncertainty: External consumer loci are source-authored references, not independently inspected implementations.

grounding.quote:
An obligation outside a frame's current
attention stays open.

constraints.statement: Transitions compose only under §4. Discovery may add obligations and enlarge known work while improving knowledge; an invalidated claim is re-established or withdrawn before reliance. Excluded attention disposes of no open work and subsequent decisions retain material dependencies. Destination revision requires authorisation and owning-relation re-entry; revised satisfaction proves nothing about the former destination. Completion requires sufficient evidence that current state satisfies the applicable destination and acceptance conditions, with acceptance reserved to the decision owner. Empty work lists, closed/remaining counts and absence of a recorded counterexample do not establish completion. Progress is assessed against outcome and evidence, not remaining-item counts.
constraints.uncertainty: The referenced complete §5 progress and §7 invalidation details are only partly present in the supplied sections.

conditions: Work cannot continue.

grounding.quote:
The work state (§5) retains the unresolved outcome, the residuals and the
obligations still owed. A stop reaches no destination and discards none
of these

constraints.statement: A stop names its cause. Failure to deliver output yields construction availability other than candidate_ready; a declared ambiguity halting work or exceeding authority yields blocked or escalated. Refused admission or activation stops work without creating a step. Work state retains unresolved outcome, residuals and owed obligations; a stop neither reaches the destination nor discards them. Intake and work state already carry state, destination and obligations, so no further carrier is required.

grounding.quote:
A
lawful construction can remain incomplete or fail to reach Z, and
lawfulness establishes neither delivery nor optimality.

constraints.statement: Construction explicitly binds A with its account and Z. The account includes workspace, relevant external observations acquired through owning interfaces, justified knowledge and unknowns; it may be stale or incomplete, and workspace remains the subject. Applicable declared requirements and tenant calculi govern lawful transformations and composition but select no outcome. Lawfulness implies neither delivery nor optimality. Premise-dependent outcome proofs retain premises and scope. Claims about specification, observation or predictive model cannot substitute for one another; model applicability and adequacy require their own support. A path may be discovered while performing and evaluating work.
constraints.uncertainty: The tenant calculi and external account taxonomy are not supplied.

grounding.quote:
Measures that justify a choice state
their units, boundaries and composition rules, and keep estimates,
assumptions and observations distinguishable.

constraints.statement: Material strategy choices account for context, attention, time, effort, computation, communication and other relevant resources, feedback delay, uncertainty, integration exposure and rework; planning, checking and coordination also consume resources. Justifying measures state units, boundaries and composition rules and distinguish estimates, assumptions and observations. Owning criteria decide tradeoffs among potentially incomparable objectives. Material rationale is recorded in existing design/work records; superiority claims state objectives, comparisons and assumptions. Frames select step material and task contracts while destination Z remains across the activations reaching it.

grounding.quote:
Local success supplies end-to-end success only when the required
coverage, composition compatibility and outcome evidence hold

constraints.statement: Steps compose through compatible preconditions, effects, results and authority; every boundary preserves applicable outer obligations. Decomposition, delegation, concurrency and recursion retain affected obligations. Local success supports end-to-end success only with required coverage, compatibility and outcome evidence. Chain obligations and demonstration of categorical claims remain those of FOUNDATIONS §4. Refinement may add detail and construction change state only within permitted variation.
constraints.uncertainty: The referenced chain-obligation and categorical-demonstration definitions are not supplied.

conditions: Feedback addresses an observed or suspected material discrepancy.

grounding.quote:
Diagnosis distinguishes four causes: a defective realisation, an
inadequate governing requirement or design, an inaccurate predictive
model, and insufficient observation.

constraints.statement: Diagnosis distinguishes defective realisation, inadequate requirement/design, inaccurate predictive model and insufficient observation; unresolved alternatives remain unresolved and supported repairs go to their causal owners. Prediction error alone does not decide outcome satisfaction; model revision neither erases counterexample nor repairs realisation by itself. A bug is feature/change work using the same intake and delivery mechanism; its label grants no repair class or permission and its list is only a projection of work state. Severity describes consequence; priority orders response under outcome, dependencies, resources and authority.

exceptions: Ongoing maintenance may continue under its mandate; a delivery claim still needs its completion condition.

grounding.quote:
Producing a candidate, proving a property and accepting delivery remain
distinct acts

constraints.statement: Preservation, evidence-based progress, termination and outcome satisfaction are distinct claims. Formal induction or termination claims supply premises and arguments; no universal termination proof is prerequisite to bounded work, and absent proof limits the claim to available evidence. Continuing work needs supported purpose, including uncertainty reduction or bounded hypothesis testing; repetition alone is not progress. Failure, missing information, uncertain effects and resource exhaustion require the named control responses. Evaluation preserves failure, missing coverage and uncertainty in the core. Proof, checking, testing and use establish only their scoped claims; an unavailable required proof remains owed. Candidate production, property proof and delivery acceptance stay separate. Exhaustion or unresolved attempts prove neither completion nor impossibility; changing Z establishes nothing about former satisfaction and preserves the original counterexample.
constraints.uncertainty: Control and evidence rules referenced in unsupplied owner sections remain unresolved.

exceptions: Allowance and spend-measurement fields apply when the governed question is a cost claim.
Design-profile supplying laws apply where that profile applies.

grounding.quote:
- the exact workspace subject and basis, and the inputs it may acquire,
  each by identity and hash or by an input commit;

constraints.statement: Intake names selected outcome, admitted prerequisite or experiment; exact subject, basis and permitted inputs by identity/hash or input commit; evaluation/family and core algebra or mapped refinement; bounded affected relations and applicable invariants; relied-on accepted transformation-admission relations; selected shared machinery and binding; construction/assessment authority including frame-set, semantic, evaluation, materially relevant operation and decision authority; grant's permitted operations, mutable territory and reserved decisions; actor envelopes; staleness, scope and re-entry conditions; and cost allowance/measurement when applicable. Implementation folklore is not a source. An applicable design profile supplies affected set, admission relations, invariants and computational dispositions through its bounded-frame conservation, admission completeness, reconstruction sufficiency and computational projection laws; intake consumes them without creating a second design package.
constraints.uncertainty: The supplying DESIGN_MODULE laws and detailed authority kinds are referenced but not supplied.

exceptions: A potentially causal seam's far side may be excluded only when the basis establishes that it cannot participate.

grounding.quote:
A seam whose far side can causally affect,
or be affected by, the action is inside the cone unless the basis
establishes that it cannot participate. Unrelated incompleteness outside
the cone is recorded as repricing input and does not block the bounded
claim.

constraints.statement: Every far side that can causally affect or be affected by the action belongs inside the cone unless its nonparticipation is established by the basis. Unrelated outside incompleteness is recorded as repricing input and does not block the bounded claim.

exceptions: Explicit human override of the exact contract is an alternative to deterministic admission.

grounding.quote:
Execution begins only after deterministic admission or an
explicit human override of the exact contract.

constraints.statement: Execution requires deterministic admission or explicit human override of the exact contract. Draft, carrier presence, lane placement, active label or prose assertion cannot establish admission, and the drafting actor cannot self-certify its execution basis. Missing admission mechanism/authority, exact identity/digest, decision or evidence leaves the contract drafted or rejected. Admission validates against the cited outcome/prerequisite/experiment basis without admitting that basis or creating/renewing unadmitted authority. Only an admitted contract activates a step; result, child completion, tool output, model response, shared actor or lateral handoff alone neither activates another step nor authorises continuation. Routing profiles name their instances of this rule.

grounding.quote:
every result, withheld closure and
residual obligation is recorded there before return

constraints.statement: The admitted contract names one durable result/evidence surface; every result, withheld closure and residual obligation is recorded there before return. Conversation return alone is not durable evidence. Admission refuses without an authorised available surface. Absent or rejected admission returns admission_refused with cause and missing work authority without execution. Carrier selection belongs to tier-2 TICKETS; separation of drafting/admission does not itself require a separate turn, carrier or approval ceremony.
constraints.uncertainty: The carrier's detailed law is outside the supplied text.

exceptions: A missing/ambiguous premise needing an undeclared frame relation yields out_of_frame rather than indeterminate.

grounding.quote:
An obligation whose applicability is
unresolved stays in that required coverage.

constraints.statement: True applicability maps to satisfied and requires the applicable evaluation/result. False applicability maps to falsified with a basis-bound counterexample, excludes only that obligation under cited authority, and removes it from dependent-conjunction required coverage; its own evaluation is not performed and has no result or core value. Missing/ambiguous premises map to indeterminate, or out_of_frame for a needed undeclared relation, never falsified; the obligation remains in coverage and the dependent claim is withheld until sufficient evidence or owning decision resolves applicability. Supported inapplicability is recorded apart from result values and waives no member acceptance criterion. An owner-declared disjunction including non-application may be satisfied by non-application, but that satisfaction counts only for the disjunction, never for the obligation-holds predicate. Members, profiles and projects refer to this exclusion rule rather than deciding it anew.

grounding.quote:
a rule that always skips or always activates cannot satisfy those distinct
expected outcomes

constraints.statement: Frame name, available tool or listed family alone triggers no activation. Residual semantic judgment and evidence remain a judgment, not a computed fact. A required result absent, stale, on another subject/basis or incapable of establishing its claim cannot satisfy a dependent conjunction. Other applicable constraints remain in force even if detected by only one evaluation. Finite declared qualification fixtures distinguish true, false and unknown premises, missing/wrong-subject required results and sufficient positive results; always-skip and always-activate rules cannot meet these distinct expected outcomes.
constraints.uncertainty: The complete EVALUATION §7 fixture framework is not supplied.

exceptions: For direct entry the intake may provide the proportional explanation, with resource limits in capability envelopes and failure assumptions in stale/out-of-scope/re-entry conditions.

grounding.quote:
Its labels, its topology, and the presence or
absence of a coordinator or of familiar roles neither accept nor reject
it

constraints.statement: Selecting design explains allocation, assumed material resource limits declared under §6 and failure assumptions in existing design, frame declarations and work records; no separate carrier is required. Evaluation considers task, dependencies, actor limits, authority and assurance, not labels, topology or coordinator/familiar-role presence. RF-009's distinct relation structures stay distinct without additions or omissions. Frame naming/selection grants no authority; each activation binds subject, result algebra, capability and admitted authority through intake and activation. Adequacy and optimality differ: optimality needs stated objectives, constraints, comparison scope and evidence; familiarity, persistence or self-organisation do not prove it.
constraints.uncertainty: RF-009's actual list and §6 resource-limit details are not supplied.

exceptions: An explicitly bounded proxy may admit only within its existing grant.

grounding.quote:
A configuration is admitted by the smallest
existing authority that owns the material decision the configuration
makes.

constraints.statement: The smallest existing authority owning the material decision admits a configuration; multiple governing owners retain their own decisions and admission creates no authority over them. Method/profile binds decision ownership. Every allocation and reconfiguration, including actor redistribution or adaptive/self-organised changes, preserves material dependencies, outstanding obligations, effects including uncertain completion, admitted authority and required independence. Obligations and dependent results move with work. Uncertain effects are resolved sufficiently before the next dependent action. Required independence retains authorship/evidence conditions; fresh context alone is insufficient.
constraints.uncertainty: External proxy-limit and independence definitions are not fully supplied.

conditions: The configuration separates bounded task execution from delivery management across tasks.

grounding.quote:
Missing
information is never assumed favourable.

constraints.statement: The coordinator keeps the longer-term outcome and decides from a sufficient bounded view of task closed results, not task working contexts. Missing needed information is acquired through permitted frame inputs or further bounded evaluation, never assumed favourable. Compact results retain every delivery-material blocker, residual and stop; small size is not evidence of absence. The Executive profile is a selected example, not a default: Worker/Writer constructs, Reviewer assesses, Executive keeps outcome, selects next work and disposes within grant while mutating nothing; that profile owns these frames, grants, prohibitions and explanation.
constraints.uncertainty: The complete Executive profile is not supplied.

conditions: Independent assessment supports promotion.
exceptions: One actor may fill different roles across different claims when independence for the assessed claim is preserved.

grounding.quote:
the assessor evaluates the
exact live subject, its authority paths, proof and installed state, not
the constructor's summary

constraints.statement: Required independent assessment examines the exact live subject, authority paths, proof and installed state, not constructor summary. The relation prescribes no actor count; role names confer no operations.
constraints.uncertainty: EVALUATION §3's full independence criteria are not supplied.

exceptions: Direct human acceptance remains required where governing product/release law requires it.
A status change alone needs neither a new grant nor rehashing an unchanged subject.

grounding.quote:
A material change to the operation, the
subject, the territory, the authority or the validity conditions requires
the affected binding to be resolved before effect.

constraints.statement: Proxy routine acceptance/advancement requires a governing declaration and remains within the external proxy limit. Human ceremony is not required at every transition when basis, cone, decision envelope and re-entry conditions are already accepted. Direct constructor entry requires capable sufficient context, existing work authority, exact intake and operation grant; no coordinator activation is required merely to appoint it. Configuration selects coordination for material context, authority, capability or independence needs, not names. Direct entry preserves admission, smallest lawful carrier, assessment and reserved decisions, and does not permit self-acceptance at another owner's boundary. One bounded grant may cover declared construction/status/checkpoint sequence; actual role transitions are recorded. Material operation, subject, territory, authority or validity change is resolved before effect. A sequence grant never lifts a selected coordinator's mutation prohibition.
constraints.uncertainty: The externally owned proxy limit remains only partially characterised.

conditions: Applicable law requires no independent assessment and reserves no acceptance.
The constructor holds the grant.
exceptions: Any applicable assessment or reserved acceptance remains required.

grounding.quote:
The
recording waives no condition that actually applies, states only
conditions that were evaluated

constraints.statement: The constructor may record its satisfied bounded result with evaluated conditions and evidence in the existing durable surface without adding a carrier, appointment, review or recreated design view solely for completion. Recording waives no condition, reports no unperformed evaluation and is not disposition at another owner's boundary. Found insufficiency withholds the dependent effect and returns the question to its owner. Carriers/profiles refer to this rule and add only their own carrier binding.

grounding.quote:
If Z, R, the required-edge semantics, the basis or the scope is not
   exact, or the closure is not finite and unique on the exact basis,
   activation returns `closure_unresolved`

constraints.statement: Compute material closure under AC-010 only on exact seed set, relation family, required-edge semantics, basis and scope with finite unique closure. Otherwise activation returns closure_unresolved and no step proceeds; guessing is forbidden. Project under AC-011 while recording excluded, external, unresolved, translated and invalidation-sensitive seams. Projection gap/refusal likewise yields closure_unresolved without a step. Material outside closure stays out; adjacency alone does not justify inclusion. The method does not require proof that no undiscovered material relation exists.
constraints.uncertainty: AC-010 and AC-011's full algorithms and laws are external.

conditions: Envelope B declares context capacity.
exceptions: Without declared context capacity no size measurement is required; other RF-002 conditions still apply.

grounding.quote:
The fit claim for a measured
   boundary and the step's fit judgment are distinct

constraints.statement: Before reading, measure selected context in capacity's declared bytes/tokens over the execution binding's declared boundary, compare capacity and record measurement, capacity and comparison. Unmeasured outside context is recorded as such and excluded from the fit claim. A whole-step fit judgment requires recorded complete active inputs or a supported upper bound including host context; otherwise it is indeterminate unless a counterexample such as measured excess establishes falsified. Correct bounded task results do not supply missing fit judgment. Measurement applies for every governed question with declared capacity, is not a budget or universal gate, and establishes fit only; adequate attention needs actual-use evidence. Other envelope dimensions and resource limits follow their owners.
constraints.uncertainty: External RF-002, RF-014, qualification and resource-limit details are not supplied.

conditions: Selected context does not fit.
exceptions: The grant may delegate actor selection or envelope enlargement in advance.

grounding.quote:
Silent
   omission to fit is never one of them

constraints.statement: Use one or more lawful fitting refinements, sequenced activations, compression preserving needed distinctions/failure detection, another fitting actor, or out_of_frame. No remedy silently omits material or reduces the required predicate; obligations stay bound, narrowing is an authorised destination change and undecided matters remain explicit unknowns. Within grant the step selects refinement, sequencing and compression; actor change/envelope enlargement re-enters the grant/envelope owner unless delegated. Compression records its preservation argument and is independently assessed only where its promotion requires independent assessment.
constraints.uncertainty: Compression-preservation criteria are partly delegated to unavailable RF-017.

grounding.quote:
Only material in the exact selected
basis is acquired

constraints.statement: Acquire declared inputs by exact identity. Missing material in an actor view neither licenses reading elsewhere nor proves absence. Use a task-serving derived surface with current sources; for another task or a stale, missing or question-insufficient surface, acquire deciding owner sections declared in the selected basis. Candidate sources, version-line selectors and other bases are no substitutes. Read selected material and actual subject and follow needed source/coupled-obligation references; corpus presence alone justifies no reading. Sufficiency is question-specific against material relations, never universal for a surface/frame/corpus. Before dependent action return missing bindings: out_of_frame if no frame declares a needed relation; admission_refused(basis) or activation_refusal(basis) if required basis is absent or unverifiable as exact. Coupled material exceeding capacity follows fit handling.
constraints.uncertainty: The detailed external basis and constraint-surface definitions are not supplied.

exceptions: A multi-owner question may be decided through a derived surface declaring every owner as a source.

grounding.quote:
It refuses to close a
question owned by another member, or one that joins the law of several
owners

constraints.statement: Actor or assigning authority selects a capable frame or declared configuration. Activation loads exact declared relations/evidence, never an undifferentiated workspace dump, and supplies the referenced frame packet. If no lawful frame/actor pairing exists, missing declared relation/capability yields out_of_frame; otherwise return the applicable activation_refusal cause. Work never proceeds through implied context. Evaluation distinguishes semantic law, observation, inference and decision and records every assumption whose failure could alter the result. Standalone derived/projected surfaces decide only questions owned by their sources; other-owner or joined-owner questions return out_of_frame naming owners and are decided from their current digests or an all-owner derived surface.
constraints.uncertainty: REFERENCE_FRAME §11's packet and §5's complete activation causes are not supplied.

exceptions: Historical workaround prose may remain when current requirement, design, runtime or test still needs its constraint.

grounding.quote:
If the prompt needs an
upstream ambiguity resolved, it names the unresolved authority gap before
fallback context is read.

constraints.statement: Prompt construction starts from the highest live authority surface needed by the question, projects the current material authority, obligations, contracts, boundaries, proof expectations and fallback conditions, and excludes historical workaround prose unless currently needed. It identifies unresolved upstream authority gaps before fallback reading and projects acquisition-selected material, including raw owner sections on fallback. Design, ODD, UX and ticket specialisations retain their referenced owners.
constraints.uncertainty: The specialised prompt rules are external references, not supplied content.

exceptions: Explicit re-acceptance can restore currentness if it records new source identities and a finding that content still matches them.

grounding.quote: A stale derived surface is not used as current for any question.

constraints.statement: For every method/carrier, a surface names exact identities, such as path/digest, of every derivation source and every source whose change can alter its content. It is current for a selected basis only while every named identity equals that basis's identity; any change makes it stale. Restore currentness only by regeneration from selected-basis sources or explicit qualifying re-acceptance; meanwhile use deciding owners directly. Identity matches establish derivation identity, neither fidelity nor sufficiency. Selected-basis owners decide insufficiency and overreach; a surface never decides these about itself. Packaging/installation carriers may refine identities and re-acceptance procedure but must name this owner.
constraints.uncertainty: PRODUCT_DEFINITION §11's released-carrier refinement is not supplied.

grounding.quote: an evaluation it did not perform has no result.

constraints.statement: Every performed evaluation returns one core value with predicate and domain outcome; unperformed evaluation has no result. Every refinement value maps to exactly one core value for its declared predicate, which travels with it; satisfied for one predicate never counts for another. Profiles may refine these domains only with single-valued mappings and no added core values. Refused activation cannot be read as step stop, availability as fitness/acceptance, carried ambiguity as resolved, or unknown effect as absent.
constraints.uncertainty: The full core algebra remains externally owned.

exceptions: activation_refusal mappings remain those of REFERENCE_FRAME §5; they are not remapped here.

grounding.quote:
A refused admission or activation creates no step, no
activation of the step's frame and no work result

constraints.statement: activated maps to satisfied only with evidenced contract admission, exact Z/R/edge semantics/basis/scope, finite unique closure, selected projection and activated_frame. admission_refused(authority) maps to out_of_frame for unadmitted necessary work authority, missing exact-contract mechanism/override or unavailable/unauthorised durable surface; name missing authority/surface and owner. admission_refused(basis) maps to invalid_basis when cited outcome/prerequisite/experiment or exact subject/basis cannot support the contract; name basis. closure_unresolved maps to invalid_basis for inexact closure coordinates, nonfinite/nonunique closure or projection gap/refusal; name failed condition and open basis coordinates. out_of_frame maps to out_of_frame for absent declared pairing relation/capability or no fitting remedy. activation_refusal retains its externally owned cause mapping. These are pre-step outcomes, never construction-availability values or work results; refusal creates no step or frame activation and returns to assigning authority or declared carrier, never as a step stop.
constraints.uncertainty: The full activation_refusal cause-to-core mapping is unavailable.

conditions: Lawful activation occurred.
exceptions: A stop with both authority and basis re-entry causes records both and takes re_entry_requested(basis).

grounding.quote:
The mapping is total and exclusive after lawful activation: the cause of
the stop selects the value

constraints.statement: candidate_ready→satisfied means exact candidate and transition evidence available. refused→falsified means governing prohibition or owner-valid construction refusal defeats construction, with that prohibition/refusal as counterexample. incomplete→falsified means execution stopped without output because a needed evaluation was unperformed, undecidable on admissible evidence, or bounded execution ended first; stop basis and residuals identify which. re_entry_requested(authority)→out_of_frame names an outside-grant decision owner; re_entry_requested(basis)→invalid_basis means activated basis no longer supports work. Cause, not wording, timing or preference, selects the total exclusive value; known preactivation mismatches use admission/activation outcomes. Availability satisfaction proves neither fitness nor acceptance. incomplete is falsified only for availability: performed evaluations retain their own values, including indeterminate; unperformed evaluations/assessment criteria have no result, never falsified, and remain work-state residuals with unfinished capability/execution. Basis invalidity takes precedence over simultaneous authority deficiency.

grounding.quote: a repaired candidate is a new candidate with its own results.

constraints.statement: For acceptance at declared boundary: accept→satisfied when the candidate closes its cone and preserves every affected governing relation; local_repair→falsified for local implementation/proof defect with coherent governing relation; re_enter→invalid_basis when governing outcome, requirement, identity, lifecycle, authority, public contract or accepted design must change; reject→falsified for governing-relation violation or undisposed competing truth path. Local defect, violation or competing path is the counterexample; repaired candidates have their own results. Re-entry goes to the owning relation because the old basis cannot support acceptance. Global correctness preserves all affected global relations without requiring whole-product proof in every local action. Repeated rejection at an unchanged boundary requires reassessing frame altitude, cone, common components, design/code placement and authority sufficiency; there is no count threshold, mandatory review count or state machine, and unchanged failed construction cannot be repeated as though iteration alone closes it.

conditions: An ambiguity is declared.

grounding.quote: No outcome other than `resolved` maps to `satisfied`

constraints.statement: Record every outcome. resolved→satisfied requires a recorded decision under policy permitting lawful probabilistic processing or human adjudication. carried→falsified requires policy allowing continuation with the known ambiguity open and a residual naming resolving evidence/decision. escalated→out_of_frame identifies human authority reserved by policy/risk appetite and absent from the step. blocked→falsified means unresolved ambiguity halted by policy or hard stop and names halting condition and what lifts it. Open ambiguity is a known false resolution predicate, so carried/blocked are not indeterminate; retain domain details. No dependent claim may treat carried, escalated or blocked ambiguity as resolved.
constraints.uncertainty: The applicable ambiguity policy is externally owned.

grounding.quote: `completion_unknown` never maps to `completed` or to `not_effected`.

constraints.statement: completed→satisfied requires subject evidence that the intended effect occurred fully and ended. not_effected→falsified requires subject evidence that the declared outcome is unattained and no later completion can attain it; name any actual partial effect. Examples include no start, ending short, an outcome-bounded interval closing partly undone, or prior action destroying outcome prerequisites. completion_unknown→indeterminate applies when neither is established, including lost responses without counterexample or full observed effect that may still act; its residual names deciding observation. Lost response, absent record or no trace in actor context is not evidence for not_effected. Unknown never becomes completed or not_effected by coercion.

grounding.quote:
The residual does
not weaken the counterexample, and the counterexample does not resolve
the residual.

constraints.statement: End status is separate and enters outcome value only as a conjunct of completed. End requires subject evidence that action ceased or never began. If action began and end is unestablished, record a separate residual naming the observation establishing end. A falsifying outcome counterexample can stand while action continues; not_effected requires no end proof and does not absorb or resolve that residual. completion_unknown and not_effected-with-unestablished-end require reconciliation sufficient for the next action before repetition or dependent action. not_effected alone neither establishes absence nor licenses repetition while end is unknown.

grounding.quote: A hard stop halts the work at its condition whatever the policy

constraints.statement: Name next moves in advance after every non-satisfied result and for every admitted condition class, including unknown. Total handling promises neither recognition of all external conditions, provider termination nor completion of every request; hanging calls, unsatisfiable demands and lost post-effect responses are different and no added algebra value solves them. Applicable policy/risk appetite chooses ambiguity outcome and records it; §4 supplies no default policy. Hard stops override risk appetite; typical classes include violated invariant/guarantee, absent required authority surface, missing declared execution/operation capability, undeclared irreversible effect and explicit human-approval gate. They yield blocked for declared ambiguity or the appropriate transition stop otherwise. out_of_frame, invalid_basis, repeated indeterminate or incompatible results require a cause-selected response: admissible evidence, another capable actor, another existing frame, frame refinement/extension, frame-set revision, changed evaluation or owning product/method re-entry. Difficulty alone does not prove another frame necessary.
constraints.uncertainty: The hard-stop examples are typical, not declared exhaustive; policy details remain external.

grounding.quote:
Coverage of the outer obligations, correctness of the local
implications and legitimate authority are premises, not conclusions

constraints.statement: Faithful refinement requires each admitted Pᵢ input to yield Pᵢ₊₁, retain every applicable invariant, expose other outcomes without coercion and satisfy the next step's domain/preconditions. Successful exact-step composition carries P₀ to Pₙ by induction under the stated premises; coverage, local implication correctness and legitimate authority are not inferred from passed steps. Non-next-step carriage requires a declared typed adapter step or specialised contract naming what is carried and declared under its owner's exact authority, context, basis, scope, preservation, loss, refusal and invalidation law. Coupled relations must fit together in some step; unrelated obligations stay outside. Every affected-set crossing seam includes its far side or states why it cannot participate. Material transition admission is one complete enclosing-relation semantic commit or none.
constraints.uncertainty: AC-016 and complete external preservation obligations are not supplied.

exceptions: When no subject law is declared, universally valid steps holding whatever the subject's laws are remain admissible.

grounding.quote:
Faithful refinement, defined above, requires exact
steps.

constraints.statement: Every refinement layer states and discharges what it preserves of its outer transformation. Refinement/rewrite is admissible only under subject-declared licensing laws, such as declared associativity, commutativity or equivalence, or the stated universal-validity exception; an unlicensed nonuniversal step and any dependent refinement/rewrite are inadmissible. Exact steps preserve meaning under the subject interpretation; faithful refinement requires them. Approximate steps state an adequacy relation and their composite an argued end-to-end departure bound. Such composition is adequate only within that bound, never faithful or evidence beyond it. Fixed per-step tolerance alone does not establish an end-to-end bound because errors accumulate. A step neither exact nor approximate with both adequacy relation and composite bound is inadmissible, and dependent composition is neither faithful nor bounded-adequate.
constraints.uncertainty: No concrete subject licensing law or adequacy bound is supplied.

conditions: A material transition is proposed for admission.
exceptions: Established facts may be reused when exact subject, basis, scope, provenance and validity remain applicable and production/invalidation are recoverable.

grounding.quote:
independently valid mixed-basis
judgments cannot combine

constraints.statement: Every owner independently derives/validates the complete relation from authoritative inputs, including relevant participants, equality joins and seam far sides unless nonparticipation is authoritatively established. Caller/owner assertions of completeness, validity, prior admission or authority prove nothing. Lawful fact reuse does not transfer responsibility, omit participants or satisfy separately required independent judgment. Function/component/role/conversation/status boundaries alone neither invalidate coordinates nor require rederivation; material mutation, rollback, authority/basis change, expired validity or actual trust boundary triggers applicable validation before reliance/effect. One exact admission-valid authoritative basis remains bound through admission. If currentness can advance after preflight, enforce declared predecessor/currentness conditions or re-enter derivation/validation without effect. Owners must use equal bases or a design-declared coherent composite; independently valid incoherent mixed-basis judgments cannot combine.
constraints.uncertainty: Concrete basis currentness laws, trust boundaries and accepted design are not supplied.

conditions: A material transition is admitted, including at direct or any supported composite/nested boundary.

grounding.quote:
failure or interruption admits the complete transition or none,
never a subset.

constraints.statement: Validate every participant/join before any effect. No subset or nested constituent becomes admitted truth; commit the complete transition once on exact basis identity or none, including failure/interruption. Partial results cannot replace owner derivation/validation and competing same-scope paths cannot establish transitions outside the governing relation. Fresh reconstruction and same-basis replay reproduce enclosing relation, basis identity and complete outcome/refusal exactly at semantic altitude. The source calls the law false for asserted rather than derived completeness; omitted participant/join/seam; unidentified, stale or incoherent mixed basis; uncontrolled basis advance; prevalidation effects; exposed partial commits; different reconstruction; or remaining competing same-scope authority.
constraints.uncertainty: No claim is made that any implementation satisfies or violates these tests.

conditions: For every admission owner and supported boundary in accepted design, with cases applicable under supported input/state/operating or threat model.
exceptions: Unsupported composite/nested forms have design-grounded not_applicable disposition and no weaker or competing path.
An excluded threat alone creates neither acceptance predicate nor defensive-work requirement; scope expansion returns to its owner.

grounding.quote: exclusion requires its owning authority, not a helper's inability to construct the case

constraints.statement: Supported malformed inputs, stale states and effect boundaries retain checks. Direct qualification observes one complete derivation/validation/admission; every supported composite constituent and owning boundary meets the same law. Reachable forged identity/membership/equality/authority and unresolved participant/join/seam/relation identity ambiguity are refused without effect. Stale input is refused; preflight-to-admission advancement causes effect-free re-entry. Incoherent multi-owner bases refuse without effect. Undisposed competing authority cannot establish a transition. Fresh-process reconstruction and exact same-basis replay reproduce complete relation, basis identity and outcome/refusal. Excluding a forged case requires owning authority, not helper inability.
constraints.uncertainty: Accepted design and concrete supported model are not supplied, so no case is asserted applicable to an actual installation.

conditions: Validation has succeeded and atomic publication is being qualified.
exceptions: Named representative observations suffice only with a design-declared dominance/equivalence proof covering the entire partial-failure surface.

grounding.quote:
Final-participant
validation failure does not substitute for post-validation atomic-failure
evidence.

constraints.statement: Observe failure/interruption at every materially distinct commit/publication boundary capable of exposing a subset, then freshly reconstruct to show the complete transition or none. For an indivisible unit establish its boundary and observe failure immediately on both sides. Final-participant validation failure is not postvalidation atomic-failure evidence. A standing claim is false if any owner/supported boundary is omitted, a material partial-failure boundary lacks observation or coverage proof, a weaker helper/manufactured refusal is used, or reconstruction fails to compare the complete semantic result.
constraints.uncertainty: No qualification observations or dominance/equivalence proofs are supplied.

conditions: Work resumes.

grounding.quote: Resumption does not imply idempotence

constraints.statement: Start from current material state, recover applicable progress, recheck each reused result's invalidators, reopen only affected support and reconcile uncertain effects sufficiently before repetition or dependent action. Do not blindly repeat possibly effected actions; lawful moves are reconciliation, yield or stop. The section's reuse trace requires exact applicability plus material-input change (including new material evidence), changed basis and declared revising-observation invalidators; domain triggers instantiate these. Handoff uses closed results without private context; reuse of a judgment does not satisfy a required independent judgment. Workspace remains the truth surface; current evidence corrects disposable actor accounts and discarding an account resets nothing.
constraints.uncertainty: The separate workspace/account and closed-result/reuse sections are not supplied; this preserves only the rules explicitly stated in the supplied §5 text and table.

exceptions: A next already-authorised bounded action may begin without renewed human approval.

grounding.quote:
a category
it cannot map is a change to this owner, not a parallel category

constraints.statement: Acceptance binds one exact checkpoint and widens neither outcome nor affected relation set. Preservation checkpoints under an exact existing grant identify predecessor/parent, territory, concurrent-writer disposition and durable evidence location without acceptance/promotion/publication. Restart proposals explain why retained-work repair is insufficient, which obligations/evidence survive and changed causal assumptions; reconstructability alone does not select restart. Progress is accepted material movement toward outcome; prerequisites name enabled obligations; preservation/repeated proof are evidence, not new progress; rejected/superseded construction is churn; discovery of hidden distance revises forecast rather than negative progress. Paperwork, code/test/commit/review counts alone prove no progress. Consumers may derive projections; finer categories name this owner and map each category to progress, prerequisite, non-progress evidence, churn or forecast revision. Unmappable categories require change at this owner.

grounding.quote:
The execution protocol of §1, §3 and this section is false if execution
proceeds from unreconstructable context

constraints.statement: The source declares its execution protocol false if execution uses unreconstructable context; constructor report replaces required independent live evidence; proxy changes governing relations beyond delegation; unrelated incompleteness blocks a closed cone; same-process tests purport to prove materially cross-process authority; or rejected activity is reported as accepted progress. The transition-evidence trace requires exact candidate, changes, proof and disposition, and rejects same-process proof of reconstructable authority where process-state loss is a counterexample.
constraints.uncertainty: These are described falsifiers, not findings about an actual execution.

allowed: Worker model, prompt, tools, internal search, process topology, repository layout and orchestration runtime are not prescribed by the method's execution relation.
forbidden: Treating implementation freedom as exemption from the bounded execution relation.

grounding.quote:
the
method governs the execution relation without prescribing the worker's
model, prompt, tools, internal search, process topology, repository layout
or orchestration runtime

allowed: Steel-thread, phased/waterfall and iterative delivery are possible strategies subject to their costs, risks and governing criteria.
Independent actions may run concurrently where dependencies, effects and authority permit.
The relation imposes no exhaustive optimisation, universal numeric budget, scalar cost measure or preferred strategy.
Existing work/evidence carriers suffice; no independent ledger, fixed role sequence or orchestration runtime is added.
forbidden: Claiming a general solver, fixed organisation, guaranteed convergence or categorical universality from this relation.
Claiming strategy superiority without objectives, comparison and assumptions.

grounding.quote:
No exhaustive
optimisation, universal numerical budget, scalar cost measure or preferred
strategy is imposed by this relation or its consumers

It establishes no general solver,
no fixed organisational structure, no guaranteed convergence and no
theorem of categorical universality

allowed: One or several frames; fixed or adaptive allocation; hierarchy, peers or contract-bounded evolving allocation may be adequate.
A directly authorised task fitting a sufficient one-frame configuration may enter directly, subject to separately required assessment.
Other frames, names or topologies are evaluated against task, dependencies, capabilities, authority and assurance.
forbidden: Treating the Executive configuration as the method's default.
Inferring acceptance, rejection or authority from names, familiar roles, topology or coordinator presence.
Exempting adaptive/self-organised arrangements from preservation and independence.

grounding.quote:
One frame or several, fixed or adaptive allocation, a
hierarchy, peer coordination, or an arrangement that changes as actors
allocate work within their contracts may each be adequate.

It is
not the method's default.

allowed: A declared bounded proxy may accept preservation, require local repair, reject violation and advance already-authorised action within its grant.
A grant-holding constructor may record evaluated satisfied conditions without added review ceremony when no law requires independent assessment or reserves acceptance.
A grant can cover declared construction/status/checkpoint sequence; a status-only change needs no new grant or unchanged-subject rehash.
forbidden: Using delegated or direct entry to waive required human acceptance, assessment, reserved decisions or selected coordinator mutation prohibitions.
Reporting evaluations not performed or treating recording as disposition at another owner's boundary.

grounding.quote:
a proxy so declared may
accept preservation, require local repair, reject a violating candidate
and advance to the next already-authorised action

Where an assessment or a reserved acceptance does apply,
it stays required

allowed: Combine fitting refinement, sequencing and lawful preservation-bearing compression within grant.
Select another actor or enlarge an envelope through its owner or an already-delegated choice.
Return out_of_frame when no fitting option is available.
forbidden: Silent predicate narrowing or treating undecided context as resolved.
Actor/envelope substitution outside the governing grant or owner decision.

grounding.quote:
Within its grant a step selects refinement, sequencing and compression
   itself; selecting another actor or enlarging the envelope re-enters the
   owner of the grant or envelope, who may delegate that choice in the grant

allowed: Implementation chooses internal evaluation order and lawful reuse.
No realisation mechanism or participant count is prescribed.
forbidden: Admitting a subset or bypassing an owner's derivation through a nested/competing path.

grounding.quote: Internal evaluation order and lawful reuse are implementation-owned

allowed: Profile or realisation selects files, event streams or another admitted owner as work-state carrier.
A different actor may resume from current state.
Consumers may derive progress/churn projections and finer categories mapped to the owning categories.
forbidden: Choosing reconstruction merely because it is possible.
Introducing unmappable parallel progress categories without changing the owner.

grounding.quote:
its carrier (files, an event stream, another admitted owner) is
a profile or realisation choice.

a consumer may
derive its own progress and churn projections from them

limitations: This is source interpretation only. It asserts no semantic acceptance, execution, installed qualification, proof or completeness.
Only the 24 supplied sections are interpreted. External documents and unsupplied ACTIVATION sections remain references; Graphify confidence and connectivity establish no normative dependency.

Source-defined procedures, judgments, traversals, transformations and semantic commits are represented descriptively. The schema supplies no operational instances or proof objects; no additional populations are introduced.
Long consumer registries are retained as source-linked ownership and dependency traces, with external loci unresolved rather than fabricated as locally interpreted endpoints.
The selected published calculus basis is identified by the request, but its full text is not supplied. Calculus claims inside ACTIVATION remain subject data.
The source's Z denotes a destination predicate in Construction relation and a seed set in context construction; these meanings are kept distinct.
The output definition's generic candidate-plus-facts wording is not converted into a fabricated candidate when construction availability says output is unavailable.
No tools, external files, project instructions, web sources or agents were used.

grounding.quote:
This subsection is the one owner of the
construction relation in this corpus.

relations.meaning: The ACTIVATION construction subsection is the sole source-stated owner of this corpus's construction relation; consumers apply it.

grounding.quote:
the
exact subject and basis identify the current state it starts from

relations.meaning: Intake identifies the transition's starting current state through exact subject and basis.

exceptions: A step may serve an admitted prerequisite towards the destination.

grounding.quote:
the governed outcome names the
